sources.snippet: Chroma 1.0 is an advanced multimodal model developed by FlashLabs. It is designed to understand and generate content across multiple modalities, including text and audio. As a virtual human model, Chroma possesses the ability to process auditory inputs and respond with both text and synthesized speech, enabling natural voice interactions.
